title: Blueberry Buttermilk-Style Pancakes
summary: Fluffy American-style pancakes with a gentle tang and bursts of juicy blueberries. They’re quick enough for a relaxed breakfast and best served warm with maple syrup or butter.
steps: In a jug, mix the milk and lemon juice, then leave for 2 minutes to make a quick buttermilk-style mixture.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt.
In another bowl, whisk the eggs into the milk mixture, then stir in the melted butter.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and fold gently until just combined; a few small lumps are fine.
Gently fold in most of the blueberries, reserving a handful for the top.
Heat a large frying pan or griddle over medium heat and lightly butter it.
Spoon in small rounds of batter, leaving space between them, and dot a few reserved blueberries over the tops.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles appear and the edges look set, then flip and cook for another 1 to 2 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Serve warm with extra butter, syrup or more blueberries if you like.
